title: The carrier measure of an integer multiplicity triple in an open set is σ-finite
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, and let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an IMRep U n. That is: M = R.carrier is a Borel, countably n-rectifiable subset of U; θ = R.mult : ℝ^P → ℕ is measurable, with θ(x) > 0 (so θ(x) ≥ 1) for x ∈ M and ∫_{M∩K} θ dHⁿ < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U; and ξ = R.orient is Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. strongly measurable and, Hⁿ⌞M-a.e., orients an approximate tangent plane of M. Then ν := Hⁿ⌞M (μHE[n].restrict R.carrier) is a σ-finite measure.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → SigmaFinite (μHE[n].restrict R.carrier)
